text:
ben: Heads up — new batch can't schedule, seeing a lot of tiny free GPU slots in us-west1. Scheduler is queuing pods, ~40 Pending >2m and a few evictions ripple from older jobs. anyone else?

sophia: yup, noticed >50% fragmentation after the autoscaler surge at 03:12. rack-aware binpacking + AZ anti-affinity created micro-shelves (lots of 0.25-0.5 card leftovers).

terry: looking at scheduler logs: `scheduler: noFit: Insufficient gpu` even though aggregate free GPU looks ok. nodes report gpu.available=0.25 while many pods request 0.5 — strict fractional policy prevents packing.

kai: that matches. we enforce strict whole-slot semantics for some workloads. can we relax fractional packing for best-effort/spot? or run a consolidation job to migrate small pods together?

sophia: short-term ops: reduce podTopologySpread strictness for inference-preemptible set, and gate new batch launches. long-term: schedule a defrag job to consolidate into contiguous "shelves" (island consolidation).

ben: oncall @sre-bot — can you spin up a warm-slot pool for short-lived batches until we defrag? also note the cost tradeoff: consolidating increases usage concentration (spikes) but lowers steady-state waste.

deploy-bot: started job r21-defrag (candidate nodes: 12, strategy: drain-low-priority -> relocate). ETA ~8m. logs: https://ci.internal/r21-defrag/1 :eyes:

kai: watch the network/IO bump during concurrent drains — recommend pre-pull images before cordon. plan: 2-phase drain (pre-pull + cordon -> drain 10s batches).

sophia: pushed a quick scheduler tweak to allow cross-AZ packing when region free <10% (patch abc123). rolling canary on canary-queue now.

terry: canary results: packing success rate up ~18%, but still some pods pending due to taints `gpu-type=A100:preemptible`. fallback to smaller single-card pools would help.

ben: good progress. immediate actions: 1) throttle new batch jobs (deploy mutex locked) 2) let r21-defrag finish 3) schedule a targeted migrate of best-effort pods into compact islands 4) evaluate loosening fractional policy for spot. @kai please monitor pending_count and evictions and add an alert if Pending >30 for >5m.

kai: on it, creating alert rule and SCHED ticket SCHED-4477 for heuristic work. CLI I used to inspect: `kubectl get pods -A -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Pending` and `kubectl get nodes -L gpu.available,gpu.type`

ben: thanks — will update infra-op notes after defrag. cc: @sre oncall if evictions spike. :thumbsup:
